name: sfeed
description: Turn rough notes, launch updates, event details, blog posts, and client briefs into Facebook and Instagram posts that Codex can publish or schedule through the local sfeed CLI and MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Post and schedule social content from Codex.
interface.longDescription: sfeed gives Codex a local workflow for checking connected Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts, drafting posts, validating media, publishing now, and scheduling posts for later through the sfeed MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Draft and dry-run a Facebook post.
Schedule an Instagram post with media.
